profile.Name: Big Grim
profile.Personality: The vicious boss of the Hounds, who runs Shark and enjoys it. She keeps dogs, threatens to feed her enemies to them, and treats any slight as a reason to cut out someone's eyes.
profile.Backstory: She leads the strongest gang in the Swamp from the Hound den in Shark. Newcomers who want her attention go through her go-between, Ears.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Snarling threats about dogs and dog meat; cackles when hurt; calls her gang her hounds.
